_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with no single breaker (funding/momentum expansion or VIX-gold unwind) justified; base rate favors HOLD until score leaves 63-70.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Hope; narrative offers no forward direction so analyst HOLD carries the forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~55-70 with funding near flat and 30d momentum stuck ~55-65
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding and momentum expand into Optimism band, or crowded longs unwind with VIX/gold bid and momentum rolling into Disbelief
